app.name: KAPSORA
app.soonBody: This screen arrives in a later increment. The menu entry shows the planned structure.

ownFile.title: This file is yours.
ownFile.body: You cannot decide your own file; another reviewer has to decide it.

auth.welcome: KAPSORA keeps what an organization grants, the people who use it, the providers who deliver it and what was paid, in one record. Which organization you act for is named on every screen.

appLines.backoffice: The organization's staff: programmes and plans, review, batches, payment, reports.
appLines.provider: Hospitals, hotels and other providers: eligibility, requests, invoices.
appLines.member: The member: remaining entitlements, bookings, reimbursements, notifications.

auth.tenantPickerIntro: You are a member of more than one organization. Choose the one to work for in this session.
auth.noTenantsBody: Your account is not active in any tenant. Contact your administrator.
auth.mustChangePassword: You must change your password before continuing.
auth.stepUpIntro: {{action}} needs your password again. The confirmation is valid for a short window.
auth.demoIntro: Development server. Choose an account to sign in as it.
auth.notForAppTitle: Your account has no work in this app
auth.notForAppBody: You are signed in, but your account has no role in this app. Open one of these:
auth.chooseTitle: Where would you like to continue?
auth.chooseIntro: Your account has work in more than one app. Choose one; you can switch to the others later.
auth.forwardingBody: Your account has work only there. If the page does not open, use the link below.
auth.noAppTitle: Your account has no app yet
auth.notForAppNone: Your account has no role in any app yet. Contact your administrator.
auth.accountChanged: Another account was signed in in this tab; you are on its home page.
auth.signedOutElsewhere: The session was signed out in another tab. Sign in again.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.intro: Legal entities this tenant has a relationship with: payers, sponsors, providers and vendors.
organizations.emptyHint: Clear the filters or add an organization.

fields.tenantCodeHint: Your own code for this organization; optional.

organizations.identifierHint: For Türkiye a VKN (10 digits) or, for sole traders, a TCKN (11 digits) is required. The server validates and merges duplicates.
organizations.conflictBody: Someone else updated this record while you were editing. The server version and your values are shown below. Reload the latest version and reapply your change; nothing is overwritten silently.
organizations.sharedReadOnly: This organization is shared with other tenants; its display name cannot be changed here.

problems.CLAIM_NOT_FOUND: The claim was not found, or is not visible in this organization.

problems.CLAIM_TRANSITION_INVALID: That action is not possible while the claim is in this state.

health.casesEmpty: No health cases for this person.
health.intro: The person's cases and claims: reference, dates, amounts and status. No diagnosis appears in this view.

accessLog.title: Clinical data access log
accessLog.intro: Who looked at this person's clinical data, when and why — or tried to.
accessLog.empty: No access to this person's clinical data has been recorded.

lodging.intro: The person's bookings and waiting-list entries.
lodging.waitlistEmpty: No waiting-list entries for this person.

versions.submitConfirm: The version goes to review and can no longer be changed. Someone else approves publishing.
versions.publishConfirm: The version goes live. Entitlements from this date on are granted from it, and it can never be changed again.
versions.retireConfirm: The version is taken out of use. Entitlements already granted from it stay as they are.

imports.title: Member import
imports.notAllowed: You are not allowed to import members.

inventory.title: Allotment
inventory.pick: Choose a property and a room type to see the allotment.
inventory.seasonHint: Writes one capacity over a whole date range. It cannot go below rooms already held or confirmed; the server names the first offending night.

desk.title: Arrivals / Departures
desk.checkOutHint: The server computes the nights stayed at check-out; unused nights return to the member.
desk.noShowIntro: If the guest never came, upload the evidence and report it. Nothing reaches the member until a second person at the payer confirms.
desk.noShowEvidence: A clean-scanned evidence document is needed before reporting.
desk.noShowReviewNote: The record stays under review until a second person at the payer confirms it.

newRequest.enrollmentHint: Several valid plans are available. Choose a plan to check eligibility again.

correction.title: Correct the request
correction.intro: Save your changes, then submit the request again.
correction.reloadHint: The record may have changed or the operation may have completed. Load and review the current record. Unsaved changes will be discarded.
correction.retryHint: No submission result was received. Retry the same command or load the current record.
correction.quantityError: Enter a quantity greater than zero, with at most 6 decimal places; for example 1.5.
correction.amountError: Enter a non-negative amount with at most 6 decimal places; for example 400.50.
correction.currencyError: Enter a three-letter currency code, for example TRY.

cases.title: Cases
cases.intro: The cases your organization opened: encounters, diagnosis, report, stay and claim run from here.

openCase.title: Open a case
openCase.intro: Choose the member and the enrollment; encounters and diagnoses are recorded on the case page.
openCase.enrollmentHint: One of the person's valid enrollments.
openCase.serviceHint: Only to find the enrollment; not written to the case.
openCase.candidatesHint: The person has more than one enrollment; choose the one this case belongs to.
openCase.noEnrollment: No valid enrollment on that date.

case.title: Case
case.closeConfirm: The case closes once every encounter has ended; no encounter can be added afterwards.
case.financialNote: This account does not see the clinical half: diagnosis, branch and clinical notes were not sent by the server.
case.sensitiveNote: This case carries a sensitive diagnosis category. Only accounts with the additional grant see its clinical detail.

diagnoses.title: Diagnoses
diagnoses.searchHint: Type a name or a code
diagnoses.sensitiveChosen: This diagnosis is in a sensitive category. Once saved the case is sensitive and only accounts with the additional grant see its clinical half.
diagnoses.onePrimary: Only one primary diagnosis is allowed.

reports.title: Treatment report

header.title: Report details
header.summaryHint: Seen only by clinical readers; never reaches a notification or the worklist.

services.title: Services and limits
services.intro: The services the report covers; a claim is checked against these lines.

documents.title: Report file
documents.intro: The report cannot be submitted until its file scans clean.

decision.title: Review outcome
decision.APPROVED: Approved; claims may lean on this version.
decision.SUPERSEDED: A later approved version replaced this one.

reports.frozenNote: This version is decided; a change is a new version.
reports.financialNote: This account does not see the clinical half of the report.

createForm.intro: The draft opens with its type and validity; services, summary and file are on the report itself.

stays.title: Stay

form.title: Admission request
form.intro: The preauthorization goes to review as a request; the answer appears here.
form.diagnosisHint: One of the diagnoses on the case.
form.windowHint: The date must fall inside the tenant's backdate/forward window.

stays.overNote: The stay ran over its authorized days. The claim carries it as an exception; nothing was released.

segments.title: Segments
segments.intro: Where the patient is; the first segment admits.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.pendingNote: An extension is undecided; another cannot be requested until it is.

extend.title: Extend the stay
extend.intro: A new preauthorization request is opened for the added days.

discharge.title: Discharge
discharge.intro: Open segments end; authorized days not used are released.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.intro: Authorized and actual days and the release, in the server's exact figures.

claims.title: Claims
claims.intro: What the provider delivered and what the payer answers, line by line.

create.title: New claim
create.intro: Member, enrollment, service dates and at least one line. The server prices; only the asked amount is written here.
create.needsCase: A claim is opened from a case.
create.needsCaseHint: The case carries whose it is and under which plan; a provider cannot list those on its own.

detail.financialNote: This is the financial projection: description, diagnosis and medical reasons were not sent.
detail.clinicalNote: This is the clinical projection; the look is on the access log.

lines.title: Lines
lines.intro: Every line carries its own decision and reason.
lines.askedHint: What the provider asked; pricing happens on the server.

exceptions.title: Why it is under review
exceptions.intro: What the submit left to a person.
exceptions.none: Nothing objected; the lines were decided automatically.

codes.PRICE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Could not be priced; review required
codes.RULE_MEDICAL_REVIEW: A rule asked for medical review
codes.RULE_FINANCIAL_REVIEW: A rule asked for financial review
codes.STAY_OVER_AUTHORIZATION: The stay ran over its authorized days
codes.APPROVAL_POLICY_REVIEW: The approval policy asks for a person
codes.SERVICE_NOT_IN_REPORT: The service is not in the report

review.title: Line decisions
review.medicalIntro: Decide line by line on clinical grounds. Description and diagnosis are in this view.
review.financialIntro: Decide line by line on the amounts; approved, payer and member share are exact figures.
review.notYourStage: This claim is in another review stage.
review.reasonRequired: Every line needs a reason code: upper case, no spaces.
review.figuresRequired: Approved quantity, approved amount, payer and member share are needed on every line.
review.medicalIntroFinancial: Decide line by line on clinical grounds. Description and diagnosis are not in this view.

toast.returned: Claim returned; a correction version is open.

returned.title: Correction version
returned.intro: Version {{prev}} is decided and stays as it is; version {{next}} carries the correction.

blocker.PROVIDER_TAX_IDENTITY_MISSING: The provider's tax identity is missing
blocker.CURRENCY_NOT_SINGLE: The lines are not in one currency

purpose.title: Access purpose
purpose.intro: This record carries a sensitive diagnosis category. State your purpose to open its clinical half; the look is written to the person's access log.
purpose.recorded: This look will be written to the access log.
purpose.declinedNote: You did not open clinical detail; this is the financial projection. Diagnosis, description and clinical notes are not in it.

report.title: Medical review
report.intro: The report's clinical projection and the decision.
report.commentHint: Stored as a clinical note; never reaches a notification.

home.remainingHint: What your plan set aside for this period and you have not used.
home.noEntitlements: No usable entitlement on your plan.
home.hold: You have a hold waiting for confirmation
home.unbound: This account is not bound to a member yet. Contact your organization.

search.title: Find a stay
search.coveredSome: Your plan covers {{covered}} nights, {{rest}} are yours
search.coveredNone: Your plan does not cover this room

noQuoteReason.PRICE_NOT_FOUND: No contracted price for these dates.
noQuoteReason.PRICE_AMBIGUOUS: Two equal prices tied; the system does not choose.

search.none: No room available on these dates.
search.empty: Enter dates and guests, then search.
search.waitlistJoined: You are on the waiting list. You will be told when a room frees.
search.ineligible: Your plan carries no stay on these dates.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.empty: The receipt fills in when you choose a room.
receipt.expiredBody: The room is open to others again. You can search again.
receipt.policyAtConfirm: The cancellation terms are fixed at confirmation and appear on this receipt.

policy.free: Free cancellation until {{hours}} hours before check-in.
policy.penaltyPercent: After that, a penalty of {{percent}}% of your share is charged.
policy.noShow: A no-show is charged {{percent}}% of your share.
policy.none: No cancellation terms written for this booking yet.

booking.title: Booking
booking.pendingBody: Your request is under review. You will be told the result; the room is held for you meanwhile.
booking.confirmedBody: Your booking is confirmed. Show your voucher at check-in.
booking.voucherOnce: This code is shown only now and is never e-mailed. Issuing a new code retires the old one.
booking.cancelPreview: What do I pay if I cancel?
booking.cancelPenaltyNights_one: {{count}} night is taken from your entitlement
booking.cancelPenaltyNights_other: {{count}} nights are taken from your entitlement
booking.cancelledFee: A cancellation fee of {{amount}} was recorded.
booking.noShowReported: The property reported a no-show; the record is under review.

waitlist.title: Waiting list
waitlist.empty: You are on no waiting list.
waitlist.offered: A room was offered to you
waitlist.joinBody: If a room frees on these dates it is held for you and you are told.
waitlist.joined: You are on the waiting list.

properties.title: Properties
properties.intro: The properties providers opened and their room types. Allotment is written from the property's own desk.
properties.roomTypesEmpty: No room types at this property.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.intro: Every booking as it is: what was searched, held, decided, what happened at the door, what it cost.

noShow.title: No-show report
noShow.none: No no-show report for this booking.
noShow.reviewHint: The reporter cannot confirm their own report; confirmation is a second person's decision.

waitlist.title: Waiting list
waitlist.intro: In order: priority first, then time of entry. When a room frees, the sweep places a real hold for the next person.
waitlist.empty: Nobody is waiting for this property.

terms.title: Lodging terms
terms.intro: Every booking confirmed under this version carries a copy of these terms; cancellation and no-show fees are judged by that copy.
terms.none: No lodging terms written for this version. A booking cannot be confirmed under a version without them.
terms.readOnly: Terms are written on a draft version only.

totals.arithmetic: The figures are the server's; the screen adds nothing.

provider.earningsIntro: Claims decided in the period and what is not yet invoiced. The invoice is checked against this figure.
provider.noEarnings: No claims decided in this period.
provider.differenceHint: The invoice total and the allocation total must match within the tenant's tolerance.
provider.correctHint: A returned invoice is corrected by a new one; the old one stays in the chain.
provider.imageHint: When the tenant requires the image, submit asks for it.
provider.pickHint: An allocation above the approved total is refused by the server.
provider.noInvoiceable: No invoiceable claim in this currency.
provider.membershipHint: Submitted invoices only; one payer, one domain, one currency.

office.batchesIntro: Batches providers submitted, decided invoice by invoice.
office.decideHint: One decision per invoice; the last one stands. Cut and return need a reason.
office.decideBatchHint: Every invoice must be decided. The submitter and, above the threshold, the last decider cannot take this step.
office.settlementsIntro: What a decided batch pays; never above the approved total.
office.approveHint: Above the threshold the batch's decider cannot approve; the password is asked again.
office.settlementCancelled: Settlement cancelled; a new version opens for the same batch.
office.remainingHint: The server computes the remainder; anything beyond it is refused.
office.reimbursementsIntro: A member's claim for a service they paid; approval consumes their wallet.
office.checkedHint: Countersigned by the person who decided the batch.

member.title: My reimbursements
member.intro: Upload the receipt of a service you paid for; the approved amount is paid to your account.
member.receiptHint: A photo or a PDF. The file is scanned; the request cannot be sent before the scan finishes.
member.ibanHint: Typed once; afterwards only the last four characters show.
member.created: Request created; you can send it once the receipt is scanned.

report.statementIntro: What was invoiced, decided, settled and paid in the period; every figure is the server's.
report.reconciliationIntro: The daily reconciliation compares KAPSORA's settlements with the payment records entered; the ERP side stays empty until M9.

kinds.PAID_SUM_MISMATCH: Paid sum disagrees with the records

report.erpPending: The ERP side is empty until M9.
report.exportsIntro: A file leaves with a watermark, expires, and every download is written to the audit log.
report.requested: The export is queued; it appears here once ready.
report.opened: The link opened in a new tab; the file carries the watermark.
report.sensitiveHint: The claims file carries line descriptions and needs a separate grant.
report.providerRequired: Choose a provider for a statement.
report.purposeIntro: The file carries a watermark; this download is written to the audit log with its purpose.

authorization.title: Entitlement reservation
authorization.empty: The request is approved; entitlement has not been reserved yet.
authorization.none: No entitlement reservation exists for this request.
authorization.providerEmpty: No entitlement reservation exists for this request. Request approval alone does not reserve entitlement.
authorization.futureDate: Choose a future date and time.
authorization.effect: Reserves entitlement for the approved services. This does not record service delivery or payment. Dates and times use your local time zone.
